keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Goal! FC Porto 1, Estoril 0. Victor Froholdt (FC Porto) left footed shot from very close range to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Pepê.
Delay in match because of an injury Antef Tsoungui (Estoril).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match (FC Porto).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Jan Bednarek (FC Porto) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

First Half ends, FC Porto 1, Estoril 0.
Substitution, FC Porto. Souza replaces Zaidu Sanusi because of an injury.
Second Half begins FC Porto 1, Estoril 0.
Delay in match because of an injury Peixinho (Estoril).

Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Estoril. Axel Camblan replaces Jordan Arnolin.

Substitution, Estoril. Sam Amissah replaces Stélios Andreou.
Goal! FC Porto 2, Estoril 0. Borja Sainz (FC Porto) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Gabri Veiga.
Substitution, FC Porto. André Silva replaces Samu Aghehowa.
Goal! FC Porto 3, Estoril 0. André Silva (FC Porto) right footed shot from very close range to the top left corner.
Goal! FC Porto 4, Estoril 0. Gabri Veiga (FC Porto) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Borja Sainz.
Substitution, Estoril. Jordan Holsgrove replaces Ferro.
Substitution, FC Porto. Alan Varela replaces Jan Bednarek.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.

Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Estoril. Ricard Sánchez replaces Pedro Carvalho because of an injury.

Second Half ends, FC Porto 4, Estoril 0.
